changes: Allow solver/checker descendants in one bounded aggregate resource group instead of assuming a single process.
Enforce one reserved logical CPU by singleton cpuset plus one-core quota, pin each tool to one thread, and impose16 aggregate process/thread slots.
Bound aggregate group memory to2GiB with no additional swap and distinguish20wall-second from20aggregateCPU-second stopping thresholds.
Charge actual group CPU and termination overhead; preserve overshoot and distinguish nominal attempt-wall sum from actual group CPU/global job wall time.
Retain setup/qualification/watchdog overhead separately in full cost and require real containment enforcement qualification before scored runs.
historical_artifact_rule: Every prior immutable snapshot is preserved byte-for-byte; new outputs/script/log/review live in this new resource-correction namespace.
validation_scope: Actual protocol validator uses document reads and synthetic arithmetic only; host capacity observation is discovery, not enforcement qualification.
